summary.text: SuAnn Olson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 8 (Baldwin), serving since 2023. Her standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Agriculture and Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Olson is a CPA, and her biography lists Concordia College.
Her biography lists membership in the Wilton Lions Club, service as a director of the Miss ND Scholarship Organization, and service as council member and treasurer of Sunne Lutheran Church.
In the interim she serves on the Advanced Nuclear Energy Committee and the Education Committee.
Her biography lists her as married to Randy, with three children.
